## 🎯 Target Branch & Strategy

- [ ] **`feature/*` or `fix/*` ➔ merge into `dev`** (New feature / Bug fix)
- [ ] **`dev` ➔ merge into `main`** (Production Release)
  > 💡 **Release Note:** The build number is auto-incremented by the bot. Do you need to update the Version Name (e.g., `1.0.0` -> `1.1.0`) in `pubspec.yaml` before merging?

## 🚀 Type of Change

- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (Non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (Non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] ♻️ Refactor (Code optimization, no logic change)
- [ ] ⚙️ Chore (Updates to config, CI/CD, or dependencies)

## ✅ Pre-Review Checklist

- [ ] 🧐 **Self-review:** I have performed a self-review of my own code.
- [ ] 🧪 **Testing:** If this is a core feature, I have tested edge cases thoroughly.
- [ ] 📱 **Local Build:** I have successfully run and tested this locally using `--flavor dev`.
- [ ] 🧹 **Clean Code:** I have formatted the code and resolved any critical `Warnings`.
- [ ] 🟢 **CI/CD:** The GitHub Actions `PR Check` workflow has passed successfully.
